captions.detailed: A radial base assembly featuring three identical, symmetrically spaced arms extending from a central hub. The central hub is a flat, grey cylindrical base with three rectangular tabs protruding outwards at 120-degree intervals. At the end of each tab is a dark grey cylindrical pivot joint. Attached to each joint is a dark grey rectangular link that terminates in a small cubic end block. Each of the three arms can rotate independently around its vertical pivot joint in a revolute motion.
captions.instruction: Generate a radial three-arm mechanism with a central hub. The hub should have three symmetrical attachment tabs spaced at 120 degrees, each supporting a vertical revolute joint. Each joint should connect to a dark grey rectangular link that ends with a cubic block, allowing independent rotational movement for all three arms.
captions.factory: Construct a central base link using a flat cylinder combined with three rectangular boxes rotated at 0, 120, and 240 degrees. On each of these three tabs, place a vertical cylinder to act as a pivot bearing. Create three separate arm links, each consisting of a small cylindrical joint cap, a long horizontal rectangular box for the arm body, and a small cubic box at the outer tip. Connect each arm link to the base using a revolute joint centered on the respective pivot bearing, oriented along the Z-axis.
